'''Duuba the Magnanimous''' was an up-and-coming [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]<ref name="TORWEB" /> in [[3626 BBY]].<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}</ref> He and his rival [[Gaboorga]] organized the charitable event called the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]], to restore the Cartel's reputation and improve their own standings. However, Gaboorga and Duuba had conflicting interests and so enlisted the help of others to undermine each other.<ref name="TORWEB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hutt Duuba is featured in the update 6.1.4 to the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as part of the "The Feast of Prosperity" anual event.<ref name="TORWEB" />
